snippet.title: DustTale: Last Genocide OFFICIAL RELEASE TRAILER
snippet.description:
IT'S FINALLY HERE
An official release trailer for DTLG! Enjoy!
WARNING: Do NOT use/reupload assets or footage from this video without team's permission. If you do, you will be copyright struck.

Game page:
https://gamejolt.com/games/dusttale-last-genocide/513360

Credits:

Video and programming by MaxHardcore (Me)
Sprites and thumbnail by Sotwound
Silhouettes in the thumbnail taken from the art by Apricoska
Sans voiced by Apricoska
Music by KaitoMori (Twix)
DTLG Team logo by Fazzy
